about: Answers in the AI test JSON (OpenRobertaServer/src/main/resources/ai/tests.md), the worlds nepoTest.aiFormat.checkAnswer made of them and the Tests-tab blocks nepoTest.aiFormat.suiteXml made of them, in the browser. Regenerate when aiFormat changes (docs/ai/nepo-ai-tests.md).

cases.name: 1-follow-the-line

tests.name: On the line, it follows it to the goal
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line at A, when the program runs, then it follows the line and reaches Goal 1 at its end without bumping into anything.

tests.name: Started beside the line, it finds it
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts at B, 8 cm beside the line, when the program runs, then it finds the line and still reaches Goal 1.

tests.name: Stops before the box on the line
tests.scenario: Given a box on the line, when the program runs for 40 s, then the robot stops in front of the box without bumping into it, and stays there.

cases.name: 3-park-in-the-box

tests.name: After PLAY, it parks in the box
tests.scenario: Given PLAY is pressed after 0.5 s, when the program runs, then the robot drives into the box and stops completely inside it.

tests.name: Without PLAY, it waits
tests.scenario: Given nobody presses PLAY, when the program runs for 5 s, then the robot stays where it is.

tests.name: PLAY pressed later, it still parks
tests.scenario: Given PLAY is pressed only after 3 s, when the program runs, then the robot still parks inside the box.

cases.name: synthetic

tests.name: Counts three claps
tests.scenario: Given three claps, when the program runs, then claps is 3 and the LEDs go on after each.

tests.name: REC starts it from B
tests.scenario: Given REC is pressed at 0.5 s at start B, when the program runs until Goal 1, then it reaches it and turns when it is dark.
